moves.name: Driven High Horsepower
moves.description:
Activation Condition: When the user’s Attack is raised.
Deactivation Condition: When the user’s Attack is not raised.

Never misses. Except in certain circumstances, successful hits with this attack become critical hits. If the remaining MP for the user’s Sunny Day is one or more when attacking with this move, reduces those MP by one and grants all of the following effects: Makes the weather sunny. Increases the user’s Sync Move ↑ Next effect by 2 ranks.

moves.name: This Match Is Decided!
moves.description: Raises the user’s Attack by 4 stat ranks. Raises the user’s accuracy by 1 stat rank. Raises the user’s critical-hit rate by 3 stat ranks.

passives.name: Ideal Weather for Training
passives.description: The power of the user’s High Horsepower is doubled when the weather is sunny. Turns the field of play’s zone into a Ground Zone when an ally turns the weather sunny. (A Ground Zone powers up Ground-type attacks.)

subPassives.name: Sunny: High Horsepower Power ×2
subPassives.description: The power of the user’s High Horsepower is doubled when the weather is sunny.

subPassives.name: Ally Sets Sunny W: Ground Zone
subPassives.description: Turns the field of play’s zone into a Ground Zone when an ally turns the weather sunny. (A Ground Zone powers up Ground-type attacks.)

passives.name: Veteran Trainer’s Ingenuity
passives.description: Restores 1 MP of the user’s buddy move the first time its sync move is used each battle. Restores 1 MP of the user’s buddy move after using its max move.

subPassives.name: 1st S-Move: Restore B-Move MP 1
subPassives.description: Restores 1 MP of the user’s buddy move the first time its sync move is used each battle.

subPassives.name: Max Move: Restore B-Move MP 1
subPassives.description: Restores 1 MP of the user’s buddy move after using its max move.

passives.name: Hot Hoenn Sun
passives.description: Powers up the user’s sync move and max move when the weather is sunny. When the user’s max move attacks an opponent, the target becomes all opposing sync pairs. The power of max moves affected by this passive skill is not lowered even if there are multiple targets. Restores 2 MP for the status moves of the user’s Pokémon after using the user’s max move.

subPassives.name: Sunny: S-Moves & Max Moves ↑ 9
subPassives.description: Powers up the user’s sync move and max move when the weather is sunny.

subPassives.name: Targets Maxed
subPassives.description: When the user’s max move attacks an opponent, the target becomes all opposing sync pairs. The power of max moves affected by this passive skill is not lowered even if there are multiple targets.

subPassives.name: Max Move: Restore Status P-Move MP 2
subPassives.description: Restores 2 MP for the status moves of the user’s Pokémon after using the user’s max move.
